issues:
The UI primary‑flow test fails at the step that tries to fill the "Date" field on the Mileage entry screen (and also on the Receipt capture screen). The TextInput components are not linked to their visible labels, so Playwright cannot locate the inputs by label or placeholder during automated interaction. Update the screen components to follow the accessibility spec defined in DESIGN.md: give each label a `nativeID` and associate the corresponding TextInput via `accessibilityLabelledBy` (which maps to `aria-labelledby` on web). Also add explicit `testID`/`accessibilityLabel` to the inputs to make them reliably targetable.

**Files to change**:
- `expo-app/src/screens/MileageEntryScreen.tsx`
  - Locate the label `<Text style={styles.label}>Date</Text>` and change it to `<Text style={styles.label} nativeID="date-label">Date</Text>`.
  - Modify the `<TextInput …>` for the date field to:
    ```tsx
    <TextInput
      nativeID="date-input"
      accessibilityLabel="Date"
      accessibilityLabelledBy="date-label"
      testID="date-input"
      placeholder="Date"
      value={date}
      onChangeText={setDate}
      style={styles.input}
    />
    ```
  - Apply the same pattern to the other fields (Amount, Category, Notes) – give each label a unique `nativeID` (e.g., `amount-label`, `category-label`, `notes-label`) and set `accessibilityLabelledBy` on the matching TextInput.

- `expo-app/src/screens/ReceiptCaptureScreen.tsx`
  - Add a `nativeID` to the date label (`<Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Date</Text>` → `<Text style={styles.fieldLabel} nativeID="date-label">Date</Text>`).
  - Update the corresponding TextInput to include `nativeID="date-input"`, `accessibilityLabelledBy="date-label"`, and a `testID` (e.g., `testID="date-input"`).
  - Repeat the pattern for the other fields (Amount, Category, Notes) to ensure each input is properly labelled.

These changes make the inputs discoverable by their accessible name, satisfying the UI flow automation and the accessibility checks. After applying the fixes, the UI primary‑flow test should locate and fill the "Date" field successfully, and the overall static validation will pass.
feedback: The backend passes all acceptance tests, but the UI automation cannot find the Date input fields because they lack proper accessibility linking. Adding `nativeID` and `accessibilityLabelledBy` (plus clear testIDs) aligns the components with the DESIGN.md specifications and resolves the UI flow failure.
